data.name: Robin Hood: Death to Tyrants
data.detailed_description:
Robin Hood: Death to Tyrants is a first-person shooter inspired by classic 90s shooters, combining fast-paced combat with exploration and secret hunting.

Play as Robin Hood as you infiltrate heavily guarded castles and military outposts controlled by a tyrannical regime. Fight through groups of medieval soldiers, evade ambushes, and search every corner for hidden treasure and secret areas.

Armed with your bow and arrows, every shot matters, rewarding careful aim and quick thinking during combat encounters and ambushes.

Search each stronghold, steal enough loot and rescue prisoners to complete your mission before advancing to the next area.

Levels reward careful exploration, progress through interconnected environments, uncover hidden passages, and survive increasingly dangerous encounters as you push deeper into enemy territory.

The adventure can be completed in a single sitting, though progress can be manually saved at save stations throughout the game.

Features:

-Fast-paced first-person combat

-Explore castles, forts, and hidden passages

-Discover secrets and collect treasure

-Battle medieval soldiers and survive ambushes

-Manual save stations

-A short adventure designed for a single-session playthrough

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core 2 Duo or AMD equivalent)
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU with 512 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
